profile.name: Alex Morgan
profile.headline: Product manager · 6 years of building useful things
profile.background: Senior Product Manager at a B2B SaaS startup (2022–present). Led a cross-functional team of 8. Launched a self-service onboarding flow that increased activation by 24%. Previously Product Analyst (2020–2022): built SQL dashboards, ran customer interviews, and supported roadmap prioritisation. Earlier Customer Success Associate (2018–2020): worked with enterprise clients and translated recurring customer pain into product requirements.
profile.projects: Led an onboarding redesign and a customer discovery programme. Built a community mentoring programme for aspiring product managers.
profile.qualifications: BSc Business Management. Professional Scrum Product Owner I.
profile.ambitions: Own a meaningful product area. Move closer to climate, education, or useful B2B tools. Keep doing customer discovery. Open to an adjacent role with a clear growth path.
profile.workAuthorization: Right to work in the UK; no sponsorship required.
profile.commute: Up to 45 minutes; maximum 2 office days per week

roles.title: Senior Product Manager
roles.summary: Own the core product experience for a growing B2B platform. Your mix of customer discovery, product strategy, and hands-on analytics makes this a natural next step.
responsibilities: Set priorities with a cross-functional team and measure outcomes.
Speak directly with customers to understand unmet needs.
Translate research and product data into a focused roadmap.
